newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel provident funds suffer withdrawals in May.
newsitem.headline: Israel provident funds suffer withdrawals in May.

text.p: Israeli provident funds posted net redemptions of 250 million shekels in May, against withdrawals of 341 million shekels in April and 210 million in March, the Treasury said on Thursday.
Since the beginning of the year net withdrawals have reached 1.29 billion shekels, the Treasury said.
Net withdrawals amounted to 787 million shekels in May 1996 and 11.93 billion in all of last year.
Provident funds are long-term savings funds with special tax benefits. They invest in Treasury bonds and stocks.

Savings accounts have also suffered from withdrawals this year. In May net withdrawals were 258 million shekels against 116 million in April and 343 million in March. Since the beginning of the year 1.29 billion shekels net have been withdrawn against net deposits of 5.36 billion in all of 1996.
